name: retail-reason
description: Retail Reason provides connected expertise for Walmart suppliers, Sam's Club suppliers, and Marketplace sellers. Ask questions about supplier operations, Scintilla reporting, Marketplace selling, and Supplier One; check drafts for pitfalls; look up terms; and convert fiscal-calendar dates. An eligible Retail Reason account with active access is required. Claude Code uses a personal access key; Cowork uses account sign-in.
